'''F1-V3L''' was a [[MSE-series|mouse droid]] used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
F1-V3L is a droid in the online video game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|'' Clone Wars Adventures'']]. When the game started, it was the only droid that could be bought with [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], but [[Sony]] Online Entertainment later changed this, so it could only be bought with [[:w:c:clonewarsadventures:Station Cash|Station Cash]].
